info.title: Overgoal Match API v1
info.summary: Client-agnostic contract for the Overgoal playable match.
info.description: Match API v1 describes the durable, authenticated owner-bound match service and Auth Boundary v1 routes. The server retains root-relative v1 paths for compatibility. See docs/contracts/match-api-v1.md.

MatchApiVersion.description: Contract major selected by the server. Required in M1; absent from the M0 prototype.

MatchAuthProfile.description: Authenticated authorization profile selected by the server.

RequestId.description: Bounded request correlation identifier accepted or generated by the server.

Traceparent.description: Server span in W3C trace context format.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds until the caller may retry.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key scoped to the authenticated principal, operation, and target. M1 must require it on state-changing match commands and replay the first completed response for an identical retry.

CreateMatchIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
CreateMatchIdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key scoped to createMatch and the authenticated principal. Exact retries replay the original 201 response.

StartMatchIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
StartMatchIdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key scoped to startMatch, the authenticated principal, and the target match. Exact retries replay the original response.

StartMatchRevision.name: If-Match-Revision
StartMatchRevision.description: Last observed match revision. A stale start command returns MATCH_REVISION_CONFLICT without mutation.

MatchRevision.name: If-Match-Revision
MatchRevision.description: Last observed match revision. M1 must reject stale commands with MATCH_REVISION_CONFLICT.

ProcessActionIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
ProcessActionIdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key scoped to processMatchAction and the target match. Exact retries replay the first completed response.

ProcessActionMatchRevision.name: If-Match-Revision
ProcessActionMatchRevision.description: Last observed match revision for the pending action.

MatchProgress.description: The next externally observable stop: a playable scene, halftime, or full time.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON or a prototype-era invalid lifecycle transition.

Unauthorized.description: M1 authenticated profile only: no usable principal or session.

Forbidden.description: M1 authenticated profile only: public transport-policy denial.

Conflict.description: Lifecycle, stale-action, revision, idempotency, or caller-scoped Legend mapping conflict. M1 guarantee.

ValidationError.description: Syntactically valid JSON that violates the request or current-scene decision schema.

RateLimited.description: The bounded per-process request policy rejected the request before its handler ran.

NotReady.description: The process is draining or durable storage is unavailable.

Identifier.description: Opaque identifier. Consumers must not infer UUID structure.

SimulationSeed.description: Canonical match seed serialized as an opaque string to avoid numeric precision loss. M1 must persist it and derive all authoritative randomness from it.

requested_seed.description: Optional client compatibility metadata. It is never an authoritative entropy source.

engine_version.description: match-engine/4 supports live mutation. Persisted match-engine/1, match-engine/2, and match-engine/3 state is read/replay-only; live mutation fails as 409 INVALID_MATCH_TRANSITION.

LaneTracePoint.description: A lane input timestamp. The required first point selects starting_lane at second 0; every later point starts movement toward lane at at_second and never applies before that timestamp.

PendingActionSource.description: Authoritative cause of the playable pause: a generated simulation event, a same-minute decision follow-up, or a next-minute continuation of retained possession.

seed.description: Optional client compatibility metadata recorded as requested_seed. The server generates the authoritative match seed.

DecisionSeedHint.description: Compatibility/replay metadata supplied by the client. The runtime records but does not use this value for authoritative outcomes; M1 replay derives outcomes from the durable match seed and ordered action identity.

lane_trace.description: Movement-input timestamps. The final selected lane is held through second 8 without an endpoint marker; each movement must finish within the advertised duration.
